entries.purpose: 导读与第05-08章同题材视觉语法对照
entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: precise comparable four-panel educational art plate for an illustrated design book, no historical forgery. Four equal clean rectangular panels in a 2x2 grid with narrow warm-ivory gutters and generous outer margin. ALL FOUR panels portray THE SAME simple side-view coffee pot with a curved spout, rectangular loop handle and one leafy sprig beside it, same left-to-right arrangement and approximate scale. Transform only visual grammar: upper left flowing botanical decorative surface pattern, hand printed sinuous vines, muted teal and vermilion; upper right strict geometric construction, circles rectangles and straight black lines, vermilion and teal flat forms; lower left Swiss-style editorial poster composition, disciplined asymmetrical grid, small neutral black typographic bars as texture, coffee pot rendered in bold simplified photograph-like silhouette; lower right playful Memphis-style flat composition, off-axis wedges, small squiggles, checker patterns, vermilion and teal with black, controlled lively rhythm. Distinct grammars, same recognizable pot and sprig in every panel. Beautiful polished print graphics on matte cream paper. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no signatures, no real artist names, no logos, no watermark. All examples are original contemporary teaching demonstrations; do not reproduce any specific artwork. Landscape 3:2.
